description: This file defines the Length class within the Opencart system, providing methods for length conversion, formatting, and retrieving units. It interacts with the database to load length class definitions and offers utility functions related to length measurements in the system.

classes.name: Length
classes.description: A utility class for managing length units, conversions, and formatting within the Opencart e-commerce system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Length object by loading length class data from the database based on the current language setting.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length value from one length class to another.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a length value according to a specified length class, decimal point, and thousand separator, appending the unit.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit string for a specified length class.
